_help: The progress board tree. Each node: id, name, status (live | building | deferred | planned), summary, todo (list of {text, done}; editable from the board), and match rules. A commit belongs to a node when its scope is in `scopes`, a changed file path contains one of `paths` (case-insensitive; * wildcards allowed), or its subject matches one of `words` (regex, word-start). Parents include their children's commits. Edit freely: the board reloads this file live.
